def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform separator between the two panels.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(1, h - 1)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[:n], b[:n]
        shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]

    sep_col = next((c for c in range(1, w - 1)
                    if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate a uniform separator row or column, favoring the rarest separator color.
    candidates = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            candidates.append((sum(x == row[0] for line in grid for x in line), "row", r, row[0]))
    for c in range(w):
        color = grid[0][c]
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)):
            candidates.append((sum(x == color for line in grid for x in line), "col", c, color))

    _, axis, pos, _ = min(candidates)

    if axis == "row":
        top, bottom = grid[:pos], grid[pos + 1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        top, bottom = top[:n], bottom[:n]
        common = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
        base = min(common)
        return [[3 if top[r][c] == base and bottom[r][c] == base else base
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]

    left = [row[:pos] for row in grid]
    right = [row[pos + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    base = min(common)
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == base and right[r][c] == base else base
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
